title: Zero-Copy Iterator Chain
goal: Build an iterator pipeline that parses strings without cloning.
hints: .iter() yields borrowed &String items from the slice.
.map(|s| s.as_str()) coerces &String into &str views before parsing.
explanation: The pipeline begins by borrowing each item with `.iter()`. `.map(|s| s.as_str())` turns `&String` references into `&str` slices without heap allocations. `.filter_map()` parses numbers directly from slices, and `.collect()` gathers `u32` values into a `Vec`. Placing `.map(|s| s.as_str())` after `.filter_map()` fails with `E0599` because `u32` does not have an `.as_str()` method.
